title: pixie
summary: A familiar story word with a West Country home.
question: Where do the early English fairy-word clues lead?
completion: Pixie has an early home in south-western English dialect and folklore, including Devon and Cornwall. Its exact birthplace and deeper root are uncertain: the evidence supports a region, not one invented town of origin.
partner: A familiar word can carry a surprising history. Follow the evidence!
